t.E950.agn: In 2025 EFSA raised the acceptable daily intake (ADI) from 9 to 15 mg/kg body weight and reported that even the highest intake estimates generally remained below this limit.
t.E950.body: It is excreted in the urine without being metabolised in the body.
t.E950.summary: A calorie-free synthetic sweetener about 200 times sweeter than sugar. Used in diet drinks, chewing gum and sugar-free products, usually together with other sweeteners.
t.E950.what: An intense sweetener that gives sweetness to sugar-free products.
